fields.name: encounter_surrogate_pk
fields.comment: Internal surrogate UUID or bigint for linkage (system-generated).

fields.name: visit_business_uid
fields.comment: Facility-wide unique visit episode identifier (billing / EMPI reconciled).

fields.name: mrn_stable
fields.comment: Master patient index number retained across inpatient and outpatient encounters.

fields.name: empi_candidate_key_hash
fields.comment: De-identified hash used for probabilistic duplicate detection across sources.

fields.name: patient_full_legal_name
fields.comment: Official name text as verified on credential (UTF-8, NFC normalized).

fields.name: preferred_display_name
fields.comment: Name patient prefers on wristband / call display.

fields.name: gender_administrative_iso
fields.comment: Administrative gender: MALE | FEMALE | UNKNOWN | UNDIFFERENTIATED.

fields.name: birth_date_calendar
fields.comment: Date of birth; unknown components use lowest precision allowed by institution policy.

fields.name: national_identifier_masked
fields.comment: Last-4 masked national/resident identifier for audit—not full PHI in analytics stores.

fields.name: mobile_phone_e164_placeholder
fields.comment: Primary mobile normalized to institutional pattern before E.164 uplift.

fields.name: home_admin_division_codes
fields.comment: Hierarchical locality codes conforming to national GB/T statutory divisions.

fields.name: residential_address_line_primary
fields.comment: Primary domicile line excluding region codes already stored separately.

fields.name: emergency_contact_name_text
fields.comment: Next-of-kin or emergency contact textual name capture.

fields.name: emergency_contact_phone_raw
fields.comment: Phone captured at triage intake before canonicalization workflow.

fields.name: blood_abo_standard
fields.comment: ABO phenotype stored as A/B/AB/O/UNKNOWN from transfusion medicine.

fields.name: blood_rh_flag
fields.comment: Rh positive | negative | serology pending.

fields.name: allergy_intolerance_aggregate_text
fields.comment: Narrative rollup of coded drug / food intolerance entries for alerting.

fields.name: visit_class_standard
fields.comment: OPD | IPD | EMERGENCY | DAY_SURGERY | OBSERVATION per reference list.

fields.name: facility_org_code_binding
fields.comment: Organizational unit code aligning to hospital legal entity & branch campus.

fields.name: service_location_code_binding
fields.comment: Physical care delivery location (tower / ward granularity) coded.

fields.name: admission_evt_instant_gmt_offset
fields.comment: Start of medically supervised inpatient stay timestamp with TZ offset retained.

fields.name: discharge_evt_instant_gmt_offset
fields.comment: Medically finalized discharge boundary timestamp inclusive of administrative lag.

fields.name: first_clinical_touch_instant_opd
fields.comment: Outpatient chronological first clinician interaction for cycle-time analytics.

fields.name: triage_acuity_numeric_scale
fields.comment: ED triage ordinal following institutional 1-5 urgency ladder.

fields.name: chief_complaint_normalized_text
fields.comment: Symptom chief complaint distilled from free text using controlled vocabulary cues.

fields.name: history_present_illness_abbrev
fields.comment: Condensed subjective narrative surrogate for CDS keyword triggers.

fields.name: attending_pract_license_number
fields.comment: Regulatory clinician practice license identifier authoritative for prescribing.

fields.name: attending_practitioner_name_display
fields.comment: Human-readable supervising physician attribution string.

fields.name: consult_specialty_rollups
fields.comment: Semicolon-separated consult specialty taxonomy codes impacting DRG attribution.

fields.name: primary_dx_icd10_who
fields.comment: WHO ICD-10-CM principal diagnosis code after coding closure.

fields.name: secondary_dx_icd10_who_csv
fields.comment: Ordered secondary diagnoses CSV without narrative embellishment.

fields.name: external_injury_poison_icd_ext
fields.comment: Optional V/W/X supplemental codes capturing external mechanisms.

fields.name: major_ot_procedure_icd9cm_cm3
fields.comment: Primary surgical procedure OPS/ICD-9-CM vol3 bridging code awaiting map refresh.

fields.name: procedure_addon_icd_csv
fields.comment: Ancillary interventional coding bundle.

fields.name: drg_chs_group_candidate
fields.comment: CHS-DRG grouping draft prior to payer adjudication—not final billed.

fields.name: case_pay_bundle_flag
fields.comment: Boolean indicator if episode falls under episodic bundled payment pilots.

fields.name: admission_route_desc
fields.comment: Enumerated doorway: clinic referral | ER | transfer | elective direct admit.

fields.name: discharge_disposition_std
fields.comment: NORM_DISCH_HOME | AGAINST_ADVICE | TRAN_ACUTE | TRAN_SKILLED | EXP.

fields.name: length_of_stay_computed_hours
fields.comment: Derived inpatient span hours rounded to tenth for throughput dashboards.

fields.name: total_charge_billed_amount_cent
fields.comment: Pre-adjustment billed charge integer minor currency units aggregated.

fields.name: ins_payor_primary_code
fields.comment: Primary insurance scheme category aligned to national catalog.

fields.name: ins_payor_secondary_code
fields.comment: Supplemental payer slot when stacking coverage exists.

fields.name: out_of_pocket_est_minor_units
fields.comment: Patient responsibility estimate propagated from cashier interface.

fields.name: height_cm_most_recent_vitals
fields.comment: Latest structured height centimeters prior to discharge.

fields.name: weight_kg_most_recent_vitals
fields.comment: Latest structured weight kilograms before billing finalization.

fields.name: systolic_bp_mmhg_last
fields.comment: Most recent non-invasive systolic pressure reading.

fields.name: diastolic_bp_mmhg_last
fields.comment: Paired diastolic component with timestamp stored elsewhere.

fields.name: heart_rate_bpm_last
fields.comment: Latest documented pulse in beats per minute.

fields.name: respiratory_rate_last
fields.comment: Respirations per minute last charted inpatient.

fields.name: spo2_pct_room_air_last
fields.comment: Oxygen saturation percent on presumed room air if not contradictory.

fields.name: body_temperature_celsius_last
fields.comment: Last core or oral equivalent temperature degrees Celsius.

fields.name: clinical_documentation_integrity_pct
fields.comment: Heuristic completeness score for required note elements (0..100).

fields.name: data_steward_quality_flag
fields.comment: PENDING_VALIDATE | CLEANSED | EXCEPTION_HOLD for downstream ingestion.

fields.name: source_lineage_attribution_bundle
fields.comment: Machine-readable lineage tags indicating contributing feeder systems concatenated.
